verdict.rationale: Docs describe several bulk-capable workflows—filtering/exporting/comparing traces via API, creating datasets from historical traces, running evaluations across entire datasets with configurable concurrency, and processing items via annotation queues—which together support bulk operations. However, this is all vendor documentation with no community/hands-on confirmation of true bulk editing/tagging UX, and some community feedback notes framework-specific limitations that could affect bulk workflows outside pure LangChain stacks.
